en.title: Maximum Total Rectangle Area with Each Stick Shortened by At Most 1
en.description:
Each stick may go unused or be used in at most one rectangle, and each stick's length can be reduced by at most 1 but never increased. Each rectangle must use four sticks forming two pairs of equal sides; a square is also valid. First maximize the total area of all rectangles, then take it modulo 1000000007.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains the stick lengths. 1≤n≤100000, 2≤length≤10000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 12, 54 and 20. In the third example 6 and 5 pair up as 5, and the other 5 and 4 pair up as 4, for area 20.
hints: Sort the lengths in descending order. If the current two sticks differ by ≤1, pair them as one side pair of the shorter length; otherwise discard the longest stick. With the side pairs in descending order, the two largest pairs form a rectangle; continue with the rest.
